config.evaluation_scope: Audit-driven revision using previously evaluated species/images; not a fresh unseen benchmark

split.rule: Preserve V2 class and image split membership; quarantine all content with conflicting class labels; deduplicate same-label content by train, validation, test, unknown_development, unknown_test priority then image ID; take lowest image IDs per existing known split

features.source: V2 frozen DINOv2 artifacts, individually hash-verified and subset by exact image ID
features.historical_encoder_revision: not recorded in V2; do not infer an original revision from a mutable model name
features.reproduction_boundary: hash-locked source embeddings; original raw-to-feature bitwise regeneration is not certified

open_set.unknown_scope: content-cleaned near-OOD bird species; audit-driven revision

monitoring.interpretation: empirical exploratory window thresholds; no certified deployment false-alarm rate
